text: The company sold 4000 gallons of milk. 2/5 of the amount of milk had passed the expiry date. 2/5 * 4000 = 1600. The cost of the milk was $3.5 per gallon. 1600 * 3.5 = 5600. The answer is 5600.

The first two zebras have 17 stripes each. The third has 36 stripes. The fourth has 36 / 2 = 18 stripes. In total, the zebras have 17 + 17 + 36 + 18 = 88 stripes. The average number of stripes is 88 / 4 = 22. The answer is 22.
Harold sleeps for 10 hours. He works 2 hours less than he sleeps. So he works 10 - 2 = 8 hours. He walks his dog for an hour each day. So he has 24 - 10 - 8 - 1 = 5 hours left. The answer is 5.

Gabriel wants to buy a car for $10000 and a phone for $800. So he needs $10000 + $800 = $10800. Gabriel has $5000 from working on weekends and his brother gave him $200 to help him. So he has $5000 + $200 = $5200. He needs $10800 - $5200 = $5600. The answer is $5600.

Let's work backwards. There were 5 fries left. Ants carried off 1, so there were 5 + 1 = 6. A raccoon stole 2/3 of the fries, so there were 6 / (1/3) = 18. Three pigeons ate 3 each, so there were 18 + 3 * 3 = 27. The seagull ate half of what Dave ate, so there were 27 + 14 / 2 = 31. Dave ate 14, so there were 31 + 14 = 45. The answer is 45.

Let's call the number of guests "x". The first venue costs $200 + $5x. The second venue costs $25x. We want to find when these two costs are equal. So we set them equal to each other: $200 + $5x = $25x. Subtracting $5x from both sides gives $200 = $20x. Dividing both sides by $20 gives x = 10. The answer is 10.
Mitchell bought two bags of chips with 55 chips each. So he has 2 * 55 = 110 chips. There are 5 people in his family. So each person gets 110 / 5 = 22 chips. The answer is 22.

There are 32 quarters, 95 dimes, 120 nickels, and 750 pennies. 32 quarters = 32 * 0.25 = 8. 95 dimes = 95 * 0.10 = 9.50. 120 nickels = 120 * 0.05 = 6. 750 pennies = 750 * 0.01 = 7.50. The total dollar amount is 8 + 9.50 + 6 + 7.50 = 31. The answer is 31.

40% of the water is used by the city. 80% of that is used for industrial purposes. So 20% of the city's water is used for non-industrial purposes. 20% of 40% is 0.2 * 0.4 = 0.08 or 8%. The answer is 8%.

Let's denote the speed on the beach as x. Then the speed on the sidewalk is 2x. The time spent on the beach is 40 minutes, and the distance is 2 miles. So, 2 = x * 40. The time spent on the sidewalk is 1 / (2x). The total time is 40 + 1 / (2x). Since 2 = x * 40, x = 2 / 40 = 1 / 20. So, 1 / (2x) = 1 / (2 * 1 / 20) = 10. The total time is 40 + 10 = 50 minutes. The answer is 50.

The price of a gold Jewell is 4/5 times as much as the price of a diamond Jewell. The price of a diamond Jewell is $2000. So the price of a gold Jewell is 4/5 * $2000 = $1600. The cost of a silver Jewell is $400 less than the price of gold. The price of a gold Jewell is $1600. So the cost of a silver Jewell is $1600 - $400 = $1200. The total price for all three jewels is $2000 + $1600 + $1200 = $4800. The answer is $4800.
Tom gets 4 car washes a month. Each car wash costs $15. So he pays 4 * 15 = $60 a month. In a year, he pays 60 * 12 = $720. The answer is $720.

Sean has to memorize his lines for two scenes and the lyrics to one solo song. The solo song has 54 lines in the lyrics. The first scene has twice the number of lines, but only a third of them are his lines. The second scene has six more lines than the song, and four-fifths of them are his. Sean has to memorize 54 + (2 * 54) / 3 + (54 + 6) * 4 / 5 = 54 + 36 + 48 = 138 lines. The answer is 138.
Let's say Harald sold x copies. Then Marilyn sold 10x copies. Together they sold x + 10x = 11x copies. We know that 11x = 88,000. So x = 88,000 / 11 = 8,000. The answer is 8,000.
The sum of their ages is 20. In 10 years, each of them will be 10 years older. So the sum of their ages will be 20 + 10 + 10 = 40. The answer is 40.
Carlton's team has 13 players. Zeke's team has 7 more players than Carlton's. So Zeke's team has 13 + 7 = 20 players. In total, there are 13 + 20 = 33 players. The answer is 33.

The tow truck pulled 10 cars on each of the first three days. So it pulled 10 * 3 = 30 cars on the first three days. On each of the remaining days, it pulled 4 fewer cars. So it pulled 10 - 4 = 6 cars on each of the remaining days. There are 4 remaining days. So it pulled 6 * 4 = 24 cars on the remaining days. In total, it pulled 30 + 24 = 54 cars. The answer is 54.

Newton picked up 2 apples. He put one in his pocket and threw the other at the tree. This caused 5 more apples to fall out of the tree. Newton picked up these apples, put all but one in his pocket and threw the remaining one at the tree. This caused another 6 apples to fall out of the tree. Newton picked up all of the remaining apples. So he brought home 2 + 5 + 6 = 13 apples. The answer is 13.

Grace weighs 125 pounds. Alex weighs 2 pounds less than 4 times what Grace weighs. So Alex weighs 4 * 125 - 2 = 500 - 2 = 498 pounds. Their combined weights are 125 + 498 = 623 pounds. The answer is 623.

It was 45 degrees during the day. It's 33 degrees colder during the night. So it's 45 - 33 = 12 degrees during the night. The pipes will freeze if the temperature falls below 32 degrees. So Carson needs to heat the house up by 32 - 12 = 20 degrees. Every log of wood heats the house up by 5 degrees. So Carson needs to burn 20 / 5 = 4 logs. The answer is 4.

Nik has 200 crayons. He wants to separate them into groups of 8. So he will have 200 / 8 = 25 boxes. Each box weighs 8 ounces. So the boxes will weigh 25 * 8 = 200 ounces. Each crayon weighs 1 ounce. So the crayons will weigh 200 ounces. The total weight will be 200 + 200 = 400 ounces. There are 16 ounces to a pound. So the total weight will be 400 / 16 = 25 pounds. The answer is 25.
George has 18 pens. Timothy has 3 times as many pens as George. So Timothy has 3 * 18 = 54 pens. Sarah has half as many pens as Timothy. So Sarah has 54 / 2 = 27 pens. The answer is 27.

James buys 2 pairs of shoes a month. So in a year he buys 2 * 12 = 24 pairs of shoes. He spends $2640 on shoes each year. So he pays $2640 / 24 = $110 on average for each pair of shoes. The answer is $110.

Janet spent $3.50 on ice cream, $7.50 on movie tickets for herself, $7.50 on movie tickets for her sister, and $8.50 on a bracelet. So she spent $3.50 + $7.50 + $7.50 + $8.50 = $27.50. Her parents gave her $40. So she has $40 - $27.50 = $12.50 left. The answer is $12.50.

There are 10 students in each grade. There are 4 grades. So there are 10 * 4 = 40 students. 8 students can try the escape room at a time. So it will take 40 / 8 = 5 groups. Each group uses their full 45 minutes. So it will take 5 * 45 = 225 minutes. The answer is 225.
Let's say the total land was x hectares. He sold 3/5 of it, so he had 2/5 of it left. 2/5 * x = 12.8. To find x, we can multiply both sides by 5/2. x = 12.8 * 5/2 = 32. The answer is 32.

Elvis drove west for 5 hours at 18mph. So he traveled 5 * 18 = 90 miles west. Then he drove east for 8 hours at 18mph. So he traveled 8 * 18 = 144 miles east. Since he traveled 144 - 90 = 54 miles more east than west, he is 54 miles east of his house. The answer is 54.
Samantha has 27 paintings. She has 12 fewer than Shelley. So Shelley has 27 + 12 = 39. Shelley has 8 more than Kim. So Kim has 39 - 8 = 31. The answer is 31.

Jennie put stamps on one-third of the letters needing stamps. So she put stamps on 1/3 * 60 = 20 letters. There were 30 letters in the pile of already-stamped letters. So there were 30 - 20 = 10 letters in that pile when Jennie began. The answer is 10.

Kris kept 9 stickers and gave 7 to Rob. So Kris had 9 + 7 = 16 stickers. Luis gave half of his stickers to Kris. So Luis had 16 * 2 = 32 stickers. Seth gave half of his stickers to Luis. So Seth had 32 * 2 = 64 stickers. The answer is 64.

There are 50 books in total. Half of them are written in English, so there are 50 / 2 = 25 English books. 10% of the books are written in German, so there are 50 * 10 / 100 = 5 German books. The rest are written in Spanish, so there are 50 - 25 - 5 = 20 Spanish books. The answer is 20.
Raymond was born 6 years before Samantha. Samantha is now 31. So Raymond is now 31 + 6 = 37. Raymond had a son at the age of 23. So his son was born 37 - 23 = 14 years ago. The answer is 14.

There are 100 pineapples per hectare. John has 10 hectares. So he has 100 * 10 = 1000 pineapples. He can harvest his pineapples every 3 months. In a year, there are 12 months. So he can harvest 12 / 3 = 4 times. The answer is 1000 * 4 = 4000.
Maggie's oven is off by 468 - 450 = 18 degrees. The percentage is 18 / 450 = 0.04. So she should set it to 520 - 520 * 0.04 = 520 - 20.8 = 499.2. The answer is 499.2.
Sam had 70 loaves of bread. The bakery has 40 less than seven times as many loaves of bread as Sam had. So the bakery has 7 * 70 - 40 = 490 - 40 = 450. The answer is 450.
